71 yo F w/ DM2, CKD, recurrent UTI presenting w/ sepsis 2/2 UTI, complicated by altered mental status + AKI on CKD.

# AMS: likely toxic-metabolic 2/2 infxn. Reorienting. Avoid deliriogenics. Monitor.
# DM2: hold metformin, ISS.
# HTN: hold ACEi/amlodipine while septic, reassess.
# Hypothyroid: cont levothyroxine.
# PPx: SCDs, PPI not indicated.
FULL CODE. Confirmed w/ daughter.
